title: Become a Remitly Ambassador and Earn Up To $1,000 A Month
summary: Earn up to $1,000 a month sharing Remitly with your community. Join the Global Ambassador Program for weekly payouts, training and flexible, no-target terms.
body_markdown:
Remitly built the Global Ambassador Program because people are already talking about how they send money abroad. Some are longtime Remitly customers, others are micro-influencers and community voices helping people facing the same decision. We wanted to turn that natural sharing into a chance to earn, on their own terms, with the freedom to choose when and how they get involved.


The program is a structured global community with training, ongoing support, and simple weekly commission payouts. Ambassadors can earn up to $1,000 USD or the local currency equivalent each month when 25 new customers send money with Remitly using their code.


If you’ve ever shown a friend how you send money home, or told your audience which app you trust, you’ve already done the hardest part of being an ambassador. The Global Ambassador Program is built around that moment, and rewards you for it.


**Here’s how it works.** Join the program, and accept the brand ambassador agreement. From there you go through onboarding by completing the training, learning our Dos and Don’ts guide to promoting your promo code and taking a short knowledge quiz. Once that’s done, you’ll get a unique offer code to share with members of your community who might want to send money abroad. When someone new signs up and completes their first qualifying transfer using your code, you earn a commission. What’s great is that the person also gets money off their first transfer as well. There’s no cap on how many people you can invite!


**Being an ambassador works around your life.** You join as an independent contractor, not an employee. There are no targets, no minimum hours, no reporting in. You cover your own costs and handle your own tax, on your own schedule.


The Global Ambassador Program is another way Remitly is working to make sending money fair, fast and flawless, this time by putting the people who already influence that decision at the center of how new customers find us.


**Ready to become an ambassador?** Sign up


[here](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/partnerships/ambassador-program) to get started, or to learn more about the full terms and conditions.


Open to eligible participants only. Program availability varies by location and is currently available in all Remitly send countries except Australia, the United Arab Emirates and France. Participation does not guarantee earnings. Any applicable regulatory requirements, such as obtaining an Advertiser Permit, are the responsibility of the participant. See full Remitly Ambassador


[Program terms and conditions⁠.](https://www.remitly.com/us/en/home/ambassador-tnc)
